ActivityLog.title: Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: Represents a real-time log entry of an action taken by an AI agent.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp or formatted time of the log.

agentName.description: Name of the AI agent taking the action.

action.description: Brief description of the action taken.

issueId.description: ID of the related warehouse exception or issue.

details.description: Short explanatory details or physical overrides implemented.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Collection of real-time activity logs from the AI agent swarm.
